$comment: The harness CLI, machine-readable. tests/contract.test.ts fails when this list and src/cli.ts disagree, when a workflow uses a command or flag not marked stable, or when docs/contract.md omits a stable one. stable: true is covered by the compatibility promise in docs/contract.md; stable: false may change in a minor release.

commands.name: run
commands.summary: Start both stacks, capture, compare, claim, gate, report.

commands.name: compare
commands.summary: Re-run normalise/compare/claim/gate on captures already on disk.

commands.name: images
commands.summary: Per image: use it if local, else pull it and verify its cosign signature by digest, else build it from the monorepo ref.

commands.name: mutants
commands.summary: Build every mutant from the base reader image and prove the harness catches each.

commands.name: version
commands.summary: Harness version, git sha, contract version.

commands.name: stack
commands.summary: Start or stop both compose stacks.

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: What this machine lacks to run the harness, and how to install it. Exit 0 ready, 1 a needed tool is missing, 2 usage.

commands.name: noise
commands.summary: The local noise store: the noise branch as a directory. record appends a night and keeps the ratchet; status says whether the latest status licenses a FAIL; history (not stable) prints the ratchet and the streak.

commands.name: guard
commands.summary: The CI guards (masks land in their own PR; an engine change needs a version bump) against a local ref.

commands.name: override
commands.summary: The local, append-only record of overridden FAILs (the harness-override issues, locally).

commands.name: vuln-db
commands.summary: The pinned vulnerability database (grype's): update fetches it into HARNESS_VULN_DB_DIR, else HARNESS_HOME/vuln-db (the only place a database is ever updated: before a run, never during one); status says which database a scan would read, its build time, age and checksum.

commands.name: prune
commands.summary: Remove run directories under out/ older than --older-than-days and outside the newest --keep-last of their mode, and an image cache older than --image-cache-days. A dry run unless --yes; never touches HARNESS_HOME state, the run in progress or the newest release run that did not FAIL.

commands.name: local
commands.summary: One command per maintainer task, planned from the same harness commands the workflows run; --dry-run prints the plan. smoke (since 1.4.0) is the two-stacks smoke of ci.yml. compare (since 1.4.0) is the gate's release step with main against the last release (the highest X.Y.Z present for all four apps on quay.io), 3 runs, no claims by default; an exploration, so it exits 0 whenever a report was produced, 2 when it could not judge, 1 for a harness fault, and --strict makes the exit follow the verdict like gate.

imageSpecs.$comment: What --a, --b and --base accept outside migration mode (src/image-ref.ts). Since 1.1.0: @sha256 digests. Since 1.3.0: the time app.
forms: <repo>:<tag>[@sha256:<64 hex>] - that app; the others take the prefix and the tag
reader=<ref>,catalogue=<ref>,live=<ref>[,time=<ref>] - each <ref> is <repo>[:<tag>][@sha256:<64 hex>]; time is optional since 1.3.0 and takes the reader's tag when left out
refused: <repo>@sha256:... on its own - no tag for the other apps to take

environment.$comment: Environment variables that are part of the contract. Since 1.1.0, except HARNESS_IMAGE_PREFIX (whose {app} template form is since 1.1.0), the SBOM, vulnerability and static-artefact variables (since 1.2.0) and HARNESS_HOME, HARNESS_PROJECT, HARNESS_COMPOSE_PROJECT and HARNESS_KIND_CLUSTER (since 1.3.0), and HARNESS_VULN_DB_MAX_AGE_DAYS, HARNESS_ROLLBACK_ISSUE and HARNESS_REQUIRE_ARTEFACTS (since 1.4.0).

HARNESS_IMAGE_PREFIX.meaning: prefix (<prefix>/<app>:<tag>) or template containing {app}, for bare tags; --image-prefix overrides

HARNESS_COSIGN_IDENTITY.meaning: regular expression the signing certificate's identity must match; empty means the default

HARNESS_COSIGN_ISSUER.meaning: OIDC issuer of the signing certificate; empty means the default

HARNESS_PROJECT.meaning: since 1.3.0. The name of this checkout's docker compose project and kind cluster, when HARNESS_COMPOSE_PROJECT / HARNESS_KIND_CLUSTER do not say. Unset, the name is tutors-harness-<the first 8 hex of sha256 of the checkout's real path, lowercased on Windows>, so two checkouts or worktrees never share a stack

HARNESS_COMPOSE_PROJECT.meaning: since 1.3.0 (an override that existed before it). The docker compose project this checkout's stack runs under; wins over HARNESS_PROJECT. Empty means the derived name. It is never the machine owner's own project, which the harness never touches

HARNESS_KIND_CLUSTER.meaning: since 1.3.0 (an override that existed before it). The kind cluster name; wins over HARNESS_PROJECT. Empty means the derived name. The name tutors-harness, which every checkout used before 1.3.0, is refused: a cluster of that name is not adopted or deleted by any harness command

HARNESS_HOME.meaning: since 1.3.0. Where the harness keeps what outlives a run on this machine: noise/ (the default source of --noise in release and post-deploy mode, when --noise is omitted), releases/ (the release records), overrides.jsonl, image-cache/

HARNESS_CLAIM_MAX_HUNKS.meaning: since 1.2.0: a claim covering more failing hunks than this is flagged in claimHygiene; a positive integer, else the default; --claim-max-hunks overrides

HARNESS_SBOM_SOURCE.meaning: since 1.2.0. Where the SBOM of each image comes from: auto or attestation (the SPDX attestation cosign attached to a pulled image), or generate (a local generator run over the image on both sides)

HARNESS_SBOM_CMD.default: syft docker:{image} -o spdx-json (on a Windows host: the same syft run in its anchore/syft container over the Docker socket)
HARNESS_SBOM_CMD.meaning: since 1.2.0. The SBOM generator for HARNESS_SBOM_SOURCE=generate; {image} is the image reference; prints SPDX JSON on stdout. Split on whitespace and quotes, run without a shell

HARNESS_VULN_CMD.meaning: since 1.2.0. The vulnerability scanner; {sbom} is the path of the image's SPDX SBOM; prints grype or trivy JSON on stdout

HARNESS_VULN_DB_DIR.meaning: since 1.2.0. A pre-fetched scanner database directory (GRYPE_DB_CACHE_DIR / TRIVY_CACHE_DIR). Scanner database updates are always switched off, so this is what pins the scan. Since 1.4.0, unset means HARNESS_HOME/vuln-db when `harness vuln-db update` has made it, else the scanner's own cache

HARNESS_VULN_DB_MAX_AGE_DAYS.meaning: since 1.4.0. How old (days since built) the vulnerability database may be: `harness doctor` warns beyond it, and it is passed to grype as its own limit (GRYPE_DB_MAX_ALLOWED_BUILT_AGE), so a scan and the doctor agree. 5 is grype's own default

HARNESS_ROLLBACK_ISSUE.meaning: since 1.4.0. Post-deploy wording only: 1 | true | yes says a CI step opens a rollback issue on a FAIL (the reason says 'open a rollback issue'); 0 | false | no says none does (the reason says 'decide whether to roll back'). Unset: GitHub Actions (GITHUB_ACTIONS=true) has the step, anything else does not

HARNESS_REQUIRE_ARTEFACTS.meaning: since 1.4.0. Comma separated artefacts (image-manifest, sbom, vulns, runtime, startup, bus), or static, or all, whose 'not collected' gap is a failing hunk instead of an informational one. Adds to what is already required (runtime, startup); an unknown name is exit 2

HARNESS_REQUIRE_STATIC.meaning: 1 | true | yes (since 1.2.0): an alias for HARNESS_REQUIRE_ARTEFACTS=static; the two add up

exitCodes.0: verdict pass or warn, or a fail overridden with --override-reason; or the command succeeded
exitCodes.1: verdict fail that was not overridden; or images ensure could not obtain an image, or mutants or kind rollout did not succeed; or doctor found a tool a run needs missing, noise record found the ratchet broken, noise status --require found a status that does not license a FAIL, or guard found a violation
exitCodes.2: usage error, the harness itself failed (an uncaught error), or an image may not be judged; no verdict was reached
